mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% over a 2-month window predicts a near-term monetary tightening anticipation, which compresses equity discount rates and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: rising inflation expectations in a tightening cycle
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite CPIAUCSL crossing the 0.3% threshold, or the FEDFUNDS rate does not rise in response.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS labor claims exceeding 2,000 for three consecutive months signals labor market stress, prompting risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are non-negative in all such labor-stress episodes, or UNRATE remains below 4.5% during the period.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in GDPC1 personal consumption exceeding 3% over a 4-week window predicts a near-term demand softening, lowering growth expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns in the following 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < previous 4-week moving average by >3% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative despite the consumption decline, or RSAFS rises concurrently (contradicting demand weakness).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly contraction in INDPRO manufacturing index below 90 for two consecutive months indicates supply-side weakness, which amplifies equity risk premia and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-positive during all such episodes, or HOUST rises in parallel (signaling demand strength).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% in a single month, the anticipation of higher policy rates compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are non-negative in all such events, or FEDFUNDS moves are reversed within 2 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in UNRATE below 4% for three consecutive months indicates labor market slack, reducing growth expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative during all such episodes, or PAYEMS rises above trend during the period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in HOUST housing starts and RSAFS retail sales for two consecutive months signal dual demand weakness, amplifying risk aversion and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < previous month AND RSAFS < previous month for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative in all such interaction episodes, or the two series move in opposite directions.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-crisis normalization regime (defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and UNRATE < 5%), a one-time monthly drop in HOUST housing starts of more than 2% predicts a near-term risk-off reaction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Regime: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% & UNRATE < 5%; HOUST < previous month by >2%
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are non-negative in all such episodes, or the regime definition is not met.
